components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The high-confidence action for form submission and the page's principal next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--primary, #6f1730); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff9f6); font: 600 14px/1.25 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -16px var(--wine, #6f1730); transition: background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-strong, #591124); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8f2943); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that keeps the paper surface visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #decfca); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #2f2527); font: 600 14px/1.25 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--secondary, #f4e7e5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8f2943); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--foreground, #2f2527); font: 600 14px/1.25 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-text-field { width: 100%; height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #decfca); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--field, #fffdfb); color: var(--foreground, #2f2527); font: 400 16px/1.5 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(72, 35, 43, 0.03); transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-text-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #74676a); } .ds-text-field:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #6f1730); } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary, #6f1730); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #8f2943) 25%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current signed-in destination in the persistent app navigation.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--secondary, #f4e7e5); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #542b34); font: 600 16px/1.25 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-nav-active:hover { color: var(--primary, #6f1730); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8f2943); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Relationship Thread
components.description: The signature sequence connecting a meaningful plan, experience, or memory journey.
components.html:
1

Plan

Turn a wish into something on the calendar.

2

Remember

Carry the story home after the experience.
components.css: .ds-thread { position: relative; color: var(--foreground, #2f2527); } .ds-thread::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18px; top: 36px; bottom: 36px; width: 1px; background: linear-gradient(var(--border, #decfca), var(--rose, #b75a6d), var(--border, #decfca)); } .ds-thread-item { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 20px 0; } .ds-thread-marker { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--card, #fffaf6); color: var(--primary, #6f1730); font: 600 12px/1 Aptos, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -12px rgba(80, 20, 40, 0.8); } .ds-thread h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 24px/1.25 'Iowan Old Style', Baskerville, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-thread p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #74676a); font: 400 16px/1.5 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-thread-item:focus-within .ds-thread-marker { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8f2943); outline-offset: 2px; }

Private by default

components.css: .ds-support-panel { border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; background: var(--secondary, #f4e7e5); color: var(--foreground, #2f2527); } .ds-support-panel span { color: var(--primary, #6f1730); font: 600 14px/1.25 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-support-panel h3 { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 400 30px/1.1 'Iowan Old Style', Baskerville, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-support-panel p { margin: 16px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #74676a); font: 400 16px/1.75 Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-support-panel:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary, #f4e7e5) 90%, var(--card, #fffaf6)); } .ds-support-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8f2943); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Us Together feels like a modern private letter meeting a shared calendar. Warm paper surfaces, restrained blush fields, deep-wine controls, and editorial serif headlines make the product intimate without becoming decorative or nostalgic. The interface stays calm and content-led: relationship continuity is the organizing structure, not a grid of equal administrative cards.

The system pairs generous reading space with compact, dependable controls. Fine rules and a single vertical thread connect what partners plan, experience, and remember. Dark mode preserves the same warm chromatic relationships rather than turning the product neutral or blue-black.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with deep-wine actions and quiet blush grouping fields
Editorial serif headlines paired with a highly legible system sans-serif
Content-led vertical rhythm and a recurring relationship thread
Fine borders, restrained ambient shadow, and rounded but not pill-heavy forms
Clear privacy language presented as part of the experience

rules.name: The One Wine Voice Rule
rules.body: Deep wine carries primary action and active emphasis; do not introduce a second competing accent for ordinary interaction.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode keeps plum, rose, and warm-paper relationships. It does not collapse into neutral black with electric accent colors.

rules.name: The Serif Tells the Story Rule
rules.body: Use the display serif for emotional hierarchy and relationship language; keep controls, validation, navigation, and explanatory copy in the sans-serif.

rules.name: The One Narrative Path Rule
rules.body: A page should make the next meaningful relationship step visually dominant. Supporting material may sit beside it, but must not flatten the story into an equal-card dashboard.

rules.name: The Bounded Paper Rule
rules.body: Prefer a tonal shift and fine rule before adding elevation; reserve shadow for the outer paper, a primary action, or a small thread marker.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Small controls use the smallest established radius, panels step up once, and only whole-page paper surfaces use the largest radius.

dos: Do organize major experiences around one clear narrative path and one dominant next step.
Do reserve deep wine for primary action, active emphasis, and the brand voice.
Do pair large serif relationship language with sans-serif controls and explanations.
Do preserve visible focus, 44px touch targets, high-contrast text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use privacy state as explicit, readable interface content.
donts: Don't turn relationship progress into a generic grid of equal metric cards.
Don't use hearts, rose, or wine as all-over decoration; their restraint is part of the premium tone.
Don't introduce unrelated bright accents, cool gray dashboards, or blue-black dark mode.
Don't add shadow to every container; use tonal grouping and fine rules first.
Don't use pill shapes for ordinary buttons, fields, or panels.
